baslik: How a Hurricane Tears a House Apart
aciklama:
A hurricane does not just push on a house - it lifts it apart. Here is the physics of the destruction.

#shorts #science #hurricane #nature #weather

sahneler.metin: A hurricane does not just push a house - it pulls it apart.
Fast wind over a roof creates low pressure above it.
That suction literally lifts the roof upward, like an airplane wing.
Once the roof peels off, the walls lose their support.
Then the wind gets inside and pushes the walls out.
Flying debris turns into missiles that punch through anything.
And the storm surge floods everything the wind did not take.
This is why one weak roof strap can doom a whole home.
The strongest houses are the ones tied together, top to bottom.
